tools.name: ucp_products_list
tools.description: List available LifeStory AI products with IDs and prices. Start here to learn what can be ordered (currently one product: a growing-up AI video from 3–10 photos of one person).

tools.name: ucp_products_get
tools.description: Get full details of one LifeStory AI product: price, availability, capabilities and variants. Use the product ID from ucp_products_list.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live LifeStory AI pricing, photo limits, video length, delivery and refund policy. Quote prices from this tool, not from memory.

tools.name: ucp_checkout_create
tools.description: Step 1 of the order flow. Creates a checkout session and returns a paymentUrl. The human customer must open paymentUrl in a browser and pay (card) - there is no agent-side payment. After payment, poll ucp_order_status until orderStatus is PAID, then call ucp_order_storyboard.

tools.name: ucp_orders_get
tools.description: Deprecated alias of ucp_order_status: returns the same structured JSON order and generation status. Prefer ucp_order_status.

tools.name: ucp_image_validate
tools.description: Optional helper before ucp_order_storyboard: detects faces in one photo and returns faces, faceCount and isMultiPerson, so you can pick the focal person (selectedFaceIndex or subjectRankInFrame) for multi-person photos.

tools.name: ucp_order_autosort
tools.description: Optional helper before ucp_order_storyboard (requires orderStatus PAID): estimates the apparent age in each photo and returns a suggested chronological order (order = input positions, youngest first), per-photo age ranges, and a confidence level. Suggestion only - apply it by sending images to ucp_o

tools.name: ucp_order_redo_segment
tools.description: After delivery (requires orderStatus PAID and generation COMPLETED): regenerates ONE segment (0-based, matching the storyboard transition order) and reassembles the final video. Other segments keep their stored output. 3 free redos per order; the generation returns to PROCESSING - poll ucp_order_sta

tools.name: ucp_order_storyboard
tools.description: Step 2 after payment (requires orderStatus PAID, else 402). Generates the per-transition storyboard prompts for the video. Send exactly imageCount images (the quota fixed at checkout), each with either inline base64 `data` or an S3 `key` from POST /api/ucp/orders/{orderId}/uploads/presigned-url (rec

tools.name: ucp_order_generate
tools.description: Step 3 (requires orderStatus PAID and a completed ucp_order_storyboard). Starts video generation. Images are optional if already uploaded at the storyboard step. Generation takes minutes; poll ucp_order_status until generation.status is COMPLETED. The video link is emailed to the customer - status r

tools.name: ucp_order_status
tools.description: Poll this throughout the flow: structured JSON with orderStatus (PENDING/PAID), generation status/progress, deliveryReady, and the fulfillment endpoint URLs. Poll after checkout until PAID, then after ucp_order_generate until generation.status is COMPLETED.
